name: Order & Sales Popups For WooCommerce
author: PixelPlugins

sections.description:
Customize your pop-ups with your own messages, images, and animations to enhance user engagement and drive sales!

• Display recent orders with dynamic information
• Add fun and recognizable country emojis next to the customer’s location
• Show product images in pop-ups
• Customize messages using built-in shortcodes
• Adjust display timing, duration, and delays between pop-ups
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/order-sales-popups-for-woocommerce directory, or install via the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen.
  3. In your WordPress admin, go to “Sales Popups” to configure plugin settings such as timing, message templates, link targets, and more.
sections.faq:
How do I customize the popups?

All customization options, including the ability to set custom messages, or display product images, can be found on the “Sales Popups” settings page.

I’m not seeing any popups, why is that?

Make sure there has been a WooCommerce order made within the last 24 hours. Use incognito mode in your browser to simulate what new visitors will see.

How can I see what the popups will look like before I get an order?

You will either need to wait for an order or use a staging website to simulate and test. In future versions we will add the ability to simulate popups within the admin menu.

Is this plugin compatible with all themes?

Yes! It is designed to be compatible with all WordPress themes and WooCommerce setups.
